G3900.b:
† ⟪παρά-πτωμα⟫, -τος, τό
(< παραπίπτω), [in LXX for ⁨מַעַל⁩, ⁨פֶּשַׁע⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪a false step⟫, ⟪a blunder⟫ (Polyb.).
⟪2.⟫ Ethically, ⟪a misdeed⟫, ⟪trespass⟫ (LXX): ⟦Matthew 6:14|Mt 6:14⟧, ⟦Matthew 6:15|15⟧, ⟦Mark 11:25|Mk 11:25⟧, ⟦Mark 11:26|26⟧, ⟦Romans 4:25|Ro 4:25⟧ ⟦Romans 5:15|5:15⟧ ff. ⟦Romans 11:11|Ro 11:11⟧, ⟦Romans 11:12|12⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 5:19|II Co 5:19⟧, ⟦Galatians 6:1|Ga 6:1⟧, ⟦Ephesians 1:7|Eph 1:7⟧ ⟦Ephesians 2:1|2:1⟧, ⟦Ephesians 2:5|5⟧, ⟦Colossians 2:13|Col 2:13⟧.†
SYN.: v.s. ἁμαρτία.

G3902.b:
** ⟪παράσημος⟫, -ον
(< σῆμα, a mark), [in LXX: III Mac 2:29*;]
⟪1.⟫ in cl., ⟪marked amiss⟫, ⟪spurious⟫, ⟪counterfeit⟫. Later,
⟪2.⟫ ⟪marked at the side⟫, ⟪annotated⟫ (Plut.).
⟪3.⟫ ⟪marked with a sign⟫ (LXX); as subst., ⟪a figurehead⟫: ⟦Acts 28:11|Ac 28:11⟧ (v. MM, xix).†

G3903.b:
⟪παρα-σκευάζω⟫,
[in LXX: ⟦Jeremiah 50:42|Je 27 (50):42⟧ (⁨ערךְ⁩), etc.;] ⟪to prepare⟫, ⟪make ready⟫: absol. (sc. τ. δεῖπνον, etc.; of. Hdt., ix, 82, II Mac 2:27), ⟦Acts 10:10|Ac 10:10⟧; mid., ⟪to prepare⟫, ⟪make preparations⟫: ⟦1 Corinthians 14:8|I Co 14:8⟧ (cf. ⟦Jeremiah 50:42|Je 50:42⟧); pass., ⟦2 Corinthians 9:2|II Co 9:2⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 9:3|3⟧.†

G3904.b:
⟪παρα-σκευή⟫, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX: ⟦Exodus 35:24|Ex 35:24⟧ ⟦Exodus 39:22|39:22⟧ (⟦Exodus 39:42|42⟧) (⁨עֲבֹדָה⁩, with v.l., ἀποσκ-, κατασκ-), Jth 2:17 4:5, I Mac 9:35 ⁨א⁩, II Mac 15:21*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪preparation⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪equipment⟫ (Jth 2:17 4:5).
⟪3.⟫ In Jewish usage, ⟪the day of preparation⟫ for a Sabbath or a feast (= προσάββατον, q.v.): ⟦Matthew 27:62|Mt 27:62⟧, ⟦Mark 15:42|Mk 15:42⟧, ⟦Luke 23:54|Lk 23:54⟧, ⟦John 19:31|Jo 19:31⟧; c. gen., τοῦ πάσχα, ⟦John 19:14|Jo 19:14⟧; τ. Ἰουδαίων, ⟦John 19:42|Jo 19:42⟧ (it is the name for Friday in MGr.).†

G3905.b:
⟪παρα-τείνω⟫,
[in LXX: ⟦Numbers 23:28|Nu 23:28⟧ (⁨שׁקף⁩ ni.), etc.;] ⟪to extend⟫, ⟪prolong⟫: τ. λόγον, ⟦Acts 20:7|Ac 20:7⟧.†

G3906.b:
⟪παρα-τηρέω⟫, -ῶ,
[in LXX: ⟦Psalms 37:12|Ps 36 (37):12⟧ (⁨זמם⁩), ⟦Psalms 130:8|129 (130):8⟧ (⁨שׁמר⁩), ⟦Daniel 6:11|Da TH 6:11⟧ (⟦Daniel 6:12|12⟧), Su 1:12, 15, 16*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to watch closely⟫, ⟪observe narrowly⟫: so mid., τ. πύλας, ⟦Acts 9:24|Ac 9:24⟧; with evil intent, ⟦Mark 3:2|Mk 3:2⟧, ⟦Luke 20:20|Lk 20:20⟧ (absol., v. Field, Notes, 74); so mid., ⟦Luke 6:7|Lk 6:7⟧ ⟦Luke 14:1|14:1⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to observe scrupulously⟫ (of days and seasons; cf. ⟦Exodus 12:42|Ex 12:42⟧, Sm.): mid., ⟦Galatians 4:10|Ga 4:10⟧.†
a: Notes on the Translation of the N.T., by F. Field, Camb., 1899

G3908.b:
⟪παρα-τίθημι⟫,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨שׂוּם⁩;]
⟪I.⟫ Act., ⟪to place beside⟫, ⟪set before⟫, c. acc. et dat.: of food, ⟦Mark 6:41|Mk 6:41⟧ ⟦Mark 8:6|8:6⟧, ⟦Mark 8:7|7⟧, ⟦Luke 9:16|Lk 9:16⟧ ⟦Luke 11:6|11:6⟧; τράπεζαν, ⟦Acts 16:34|Ac 16:34⟧; pass. ptcp., ⟦Luke 10:8|Lk 10:8⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 10:27|I Co 10:27⟧; metaph., of teaching, παραβολήν, ⟦Matthew 13:24|Mt 13:24⟧, ⟦Matthew 13:31|31⟧.
⟪II.⟫ Mid.,
	⟪1.⟫ ⟪to have set before one⟫ (Hom., Thuc., Xen., al.).
	⟪2.⟫ ⟪to deposit⟫ with another, ⟪give in charge⟫ or ⟪commit⟫ to (Hdt., Xen., Polyb., al.) : c. acc. et dat., ⟦Luke 12:48|Lk 12:48⟧ ⟦Luke 23:46|23:46⟧, ⟦Acts 14:23|Ac 14:23⟧ ⟦Acts 20:32|20:32⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 1:18|I Ti 1:18⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 2:2|II Ti 2:2⟧, ⟦1 Peter 4:19|I Pe 4:19⟧.
	⟪3.⟫ ⟪to bring forward⟫, ⟪quote as evidence⟫: seq. ὅτι, ⟦Acts 17:3|Ac 17:3⟧ (v. Page, in l.).†
a: The Acts of the Apostles, by T. E. Page. Macmillan, 1903

G3910.b:
⟪παρ-αυτίκα⟫, adv.
(< πάραυτα = παρ’ αὐτά, sc. τὰ πράγματα), [in LXX: ⟦Psalms 70:3|Ps 69 (70):3⟧, To 4:14*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪immediately⟫.
⟪2.⟫ C. subst., to express brief duration (cf. ἡ π. λαμπρότης, Thuc., ii, 64), ⟪momentary⟫, ⟪for a moment⟫: ⟦2 Corinthians 4:17|II Co 4:17⟧.†

G3911.b:
⟪παρα-φέρω⟫,
[in LXX: ⟦1 Samuel 21:13|I Ki 21:13⟧ (⟦1 Samuel 21:14|14⟧) (⁨הלל⁩ hithpo.), and as v.l.2*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to bring to⟫, ⟪set before⟫, esp. of food (Hdt., al.).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to take⟫ or ⟪carry away⟫: c. acc. rei, seq. ἀπό, ⟦Mark 14:36|Mk 14:36⟧, ⟦Luke 22:42|Lk 22:42⟧; pass., seq. ὑπό, ⟦Jude 1:12|Ju 12⟧; metaph., pass., c. dat., ⟦Hebrews 13:9|He 13:9⟧.†

G3912.b:
⟪παρα-φρονέω⟫
(< παρά, φρήν), [in LXX: ⟦Zechariah 7:11|Za 7:11⟧ (⁨סרר⁩)*;] ⟪to be beside oneself⟫, ⟪be deranged⟫: ⟦2 Corinthians 11:23|II Co 11:23⟧.†

G3914.b: * ⟪παρα-χειμάζω⟫, ⟪to winter at⟫ a place: seq. εἰς, ⟦Acts 27:12|Ac 27:12⟧; ἐν, ⟦Acts 28:11|Ac 28:11⟧; πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ⟦1 Corinthians 16:6|I Co 16:6⟧; ἐκεῖ, ⟦Titus 3:12|Tit 3:12⟧.†

G3916.b:
⟪παραχρῆμα⟫, adv.
(= παρὰ τὸ χρῆμα), [in LXX: ⟦Numbers 6:9|Nu 6:9⟧ ⟦Numbers 12:4|12:4⟧, ⟦Isaiah 29:5|Is 29:5⟧ ⟦Isaiah 30:13|30:13⟧ (⁨פִּתְאֹם⁩), etc.;] ⟪on the spot⟫, ⟪forthwith⟫, ⟪instantly⟫: ⟦Matthew 21:19|Mt 21:19⟧, ⟦Matthew 21:20|20⟧, ⟦Luke 1:64|Lk 1:64⟧ ⟦Luke 4:39|4:39⟧ ⟦Luke 5:25|5:25⟧ ⟦Luke 8:44|8:44⟧, ⟦Luke 8:47|47⟧, ⟦Luke 8:55|55⟧ ⟦Luke 13:13|13:13⟧ ⟦Luke 18:43|18:43⟧ ⟦Luke 19:11|19:11⟧ ⟦Luke 22:60|22:60⟧, ⟦Acts 3:7|Ac 3:7⟧ ⟦Acts 5:10|5:10⟧ ⟦Acts 12:23|12:23⟧ ⟦Acts 13:11|13:11⟧ ⟦Acts 16:26|16:26⟧, ⟦Acts 16:33|33⟧ (on the usage in Mt, Lk, v. Dalman, Words, 28 f.).†
a: The Words of Jesus, by G. Dalman. English Edition. T. & T. Clark, 1902

G3917.b:
⟪πάρδαλις⟫, -εως, ἡ,
[in LXX for ⁨נָמֵר⁩, ⟦Song of Solomon 4:8|Ca 4:8⟧, ⟦Hosea 13:7|Ho 13:7⟧, ⟦Isaiah 11:6|Is 11:6⟧, al.;] ⟪a panther⟫, ⟪leopard⟫: ⟦Revelation 13:2|Re 13:2⟧.†

a: Notes on the Translation of the N.T., by F. Field, Camb., 1899

G3919.b:
* ⟪παρ-εισ-άγω⟫,
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to lead in by one's side⟫, ⟪bring forward⟫, ⟪introduce⟫.
⟪2.⟫ In late writers, ⟪to introduce⟫ or ⟪bring in secretly⟫: ⟦2 Peter 2:1|II Pe 2:1⟧.†

G3920.b:
*† ⟪παρ-είσ-ακτος⟫, -ον
(< παρεισάγω), ⟪brought in secretly⟫ (as spies or traitors): ⟦Galatians 2:4|Ga 2:4⟧.†

G3921.b:
* ⟪παρ-εισ-δύω⟫
(also -δύνω), ⟪to slip in secretly⟫, ⟪steal in⟫: παρεισεδύησαν (vulgar aor.; pass. for act., Bl., § 19, 2), ⟦Jude 1:4|Ju 4⟧ (cf. also MM, xix).†

G3922.b:
* ⟪παρ-εισ-έρχομαι⟫,
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to come in beside⟫ or ⟪by the way⟫: ⟦Romans 5:20|Ro 5:20⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to come in secretly⟫, ⟪steal in⟫: ⟦Galatians 2:4|Ga 2:4⟧.†

G3923.b: * ⟪παρ-εισ-φέρω⟫, ⟪to bring in⟫ or ⟪supply besides⟫: σπουδὴν π. (late Gk. for cl. σ. ποιεῖσθαι; cf. Deiss., BS, 361), ⟦2 Peter 1:5|II Pe 1:5⟧.†
a: Bible Studies, by G. A. Deissmann. Second English Edition, including Bibelstudien and Neue Bibelstudien, tr. by A. Grieve. T. & T. Clark, 1909

G3924.b:
**† ⟪παρ-εκτός⟫, = cl. παρέκ, -έξ,
[in Aq.: ⟦Deuteronomy 1:36|De 1:36⟧; Al., ⟦Leviticus 23:38|Le 23:38⟧*;]
⟪1.⟫ as adv., ⟪besides⟫, ⟪in addition⟫: τὰ π. (sc. γινόμενα), ⟦2 Corinthians 11:28|II Co 11:28⟧.
⟪2.⟫ As prep. c. gen., ⟪except⟫: ⟦Matthew 5:32|Mt 5:32⟧ ⟦Matthew 19:9|19:9⟧ (WH, mg., R, mg.), ⟦Acts 26:29|Ac 26:29⟧.†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881
The New Phrynichus, by W. G. Rutherford. Macmillan, 1881
The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G3926.b:
⟪παρ-εν-οχλέω⟫, -ῶ
(cf. ἐνοχλέω), [in LXX for ⁨לאה⁩ hi. (⟦Micah 6:3|Mi 6:3⟧), etc.;] ⟪to annoy⟫ concerning a matter (παρά): c. dat. pers., ⟦Acts 15:19|Ac 15:19⟧.†

G3927.b:
† ⟪παρ-επί-δημος⟫, -ον
(v.s. ἐπιδημέω), [in LXX: ⟦Genesis 23:4|Ge 23:4⟧, ⟦Psalms 39:12|Ps 38 (39):12⟧ (⁨תּוֹשָׁב⁩)*;] ⟪sojourning in a strange place⟫; as subst., ὁ π., ⟪a sojourner⟫: of Christians, ⟦1 Peter 1:1|I Pe 1:1⟧; ξένοι καὶ π., ⟦Hebrews 11:13|He 11:13⟧; πάροικοι καὶ π., ⟦1 Peter 2:11|I Pe 2:11⟧ (v. Deiss., BS, 149).†
a: Bible Studies, by G. A. Deissmann. Second English Edition, including Bibelstudien and Neue Bibelstudien, tr. by A. Grieve. T. & T. Clark, 1909

G3929.b:
* ⟪πάρεσις⟫, -εως, ἡ
(< παρίημι),
⟪1.⟫ ⟪a letting go⟫, ⟪dismissal⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪prætermission⟫, ⟪passing by⟫ (of debt or sin): ⟦Romans 3:25|Ro 3:25⟧.†
SYN.: ἄφεσις, q.v.

G3930.b:
⟪παρ-έχω⟫,
[in LXX: ⟦Psalms 30:7|Ps 29 (30):7⟧ (⁨עמד⁩ hi.), etc.;]
⟪I.⟫ Act.,
	⟪1.⟫ ⟪to furnish⟫, ⟪provide⟫, ⟪supply⟫; with ref. to incorporeal things, ⟪to afford⟫, ⟪show⟫, ⟪give⟫, ⟪cause⟫: c. acc., ⟦Acts 22:2|Ac 22:2⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 1:4|I Ti 1:4⟧; c. acc. et dat., ⟦Matthew 26:10|Mt 26:10⟧, ⟦Mark 14:6|Mk 14:6⟧, ⟦Luke 11:7|Lk 11:7⟧ ⟦Luke 18:5|18:5⟧, ⟦Acts 16:16|Ac 16:16⟧ ⟦Acts 17:31|17:31⟧ ⟦Acts 28:2|28:2⟧, ⟦Galatians 6:17|Ga 6:17⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 6:17|I Ti 6:17⟧.
	⟪2.⟫ ⟪to present⟫, ⟪offer⟫: c. acc. et dat., ⟦Luke 6:29|Lk 6:29⟧; c. prop. reflex. et acc. pred., ⟪to show⟫ or ⟪present oneself⟫ (v. infr., and cf. Bl., § 55, 1).
⟪II.⟫ Mid.,
	⟪1.⟫ ⟪to supply⟫, ⟪furnish⟫ or ⟪display of one's own⟫ part: c. acc. et dat., ⟦Luke 7:4|Lk 7:4⟧, ⟦Acts 19:24|Ac 19:24⟧, ⟦Colossians 4:1|Col 4:1⟧.
	⟪2.⟫ In late writers, c. prop. reflex. et acc. pred. (= act. ut supr.), ⟪to show⟫ or ⟪present oneself⟫ (Xen., FlJ, al.; cf. M, Pr., 248; Deiss., BS, 254): ⟦Titus 2:7|Tit 2:7⟧.†
a: Bible Studies, by G. A. Deissmann. Second English Edition, including Bibelstudien and Neue Bibelstudien, tr. by A. Grieve. T. & T. Clark, 1909
A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

G3931.b:
** ⟪παρηγορία⟫, -ας, ἡ
(< παρηγορέω, to address, exhort, console), [in LXX: IV Mac 5:12 6:1*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪an address⟫, ⟪exhortation⟫ (LXX, IV Mac 5:12 6:1).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪comfort⟫, ⟪consolation⟫: ⟦Colossians 4:11|Col 4:11⟧.†

G3932.b:
⟪παρθενία⟫, -ας, ἡ
(< παρθένος), [in LXX: ⟦Jeremiah 3:4|Je 3:4⟧ (⁨נְעוּרִים⁩), Si 15:2 42:10, IV Mac 18:8*;] ⟪virginity⟫: ⟦Luke 2:36|Lk 2:36⟧.†

G3933.b:
⟪παρθένος⟫, -ου, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨בְּתוּלָה⁩, ⟦Exodus 22:16|Ex 22:16⟧ (⟦Exodus 22:15|15⟧), ⟦Job 31:1|Jb 31:1⟧, ⟦Isaiah 23:4|Is 23:4⟧, al.; also for ⁨נַעַר⁩, ⁨נַעֲרָה⁩, ⟦Genesis 24:14|Ge 24:14⟧, ⟦Genesis 24:16|16⟧, ⟦Genesis 24:55|55⟧ ⟦Genesis 34:3|34:3⟧, and for ⁨עַלְמָה⁩, ⟦Genesis 24:43|Ge 24:43⟧, ⟦Isaiah 7:14|Is 7:14⟧;] ⟪a maiden⟫, ⟪virgin⟫: ⟦Matthew 1:23|Mt 1:23⟧(LXX) ⟦Matthew 25:1|25:1⟧, ⟦Matthew 25:7|7⟧, ⟦Matthew 25:11|11⟧, ⟦Luke 1:27|Lk 1:27⟧, ⟦Acts 21:9|Ac 21:9⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:25|I Co 7:25⟧ ff., ⟦2 Corinthians 11:2|II Co 11:2⟧; masc., of chaste persons (CIG, 8784 b): ⟦Revelation 14:4|Re 14:4⟧.†

G3935.b:
⟪παρ-ίημι⟫,
[in LXX: ⟦Jeremiah 4:31|Je 4:31⟧ (⁨פּרשׂ⁩ pi.), etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to pass by⟫ or ⟪over⟫, ⟪let alone⟫, ⟪disregard⟫: ⟦Luke 11:42|Lk 11:42⟧.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to relax⟫, ⟪loosen⟫; pass., ⟪to be relaxed⟫, ⟪weakened⟫, ⟪exhausted⟫: παρειμένας χεῖρας, ⟦Hebrews 12:12|He 12:12⟧ (LXX ἀνειμ-).†

G3936.b:
⟪παρ-ίστημι⟫,
[in LXX for ⁨עמד⁩, etc.;]
⟪I.⟫ Trans. verb. in pres., impf., fut., 1 aor.;
	⟪1.⟫ ⟪to place beside⟫, ⟪present⟫, ⟪provide⟫: c. acc., ⟦Acts 9:41|Ac 9:41⟧ ⟦Acts 23:24|23:24⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 4:14|II Co 4:14⟧, ⟦Colossians 1:28|Col 1:28⟧; c. acc. et dat., ⟦Matthew 26:53|Mt 26:53⟧, ⟦Luke 2:22|Lk 2:22⟧, ⟦Acts 1:3|Ac 1:3⟧ ⟦Acts 23:33|23:33⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 8:8|I Co 8:8⟧; seq. acc. pred., ⟦Romans 6:13|Ro 6:13⟧, ⟦Romans 6:16|16⟧ (late pres., παριστάνετε), ⟦Romans 6:19|Ro 6:19⟧ ⟦Romans 12:1|12:1⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 11:2|II Co 11:2⟧, ⟦Ephesians 5:27|Eph 5:27⟧, ⟦Colossians 1:22|Col 1:22⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 2:15|II Ti 2:15⟧.
	⟪2.⟫ ⟪to present to the mind⟫ (cl.): by argument, ⟪to prove⟫ (Xen., FlJ, al.), c. acc., ⟦Acts 24:13|Ac 24:13⟧.
⟪II.⟫ Intrans. in pf., plpf., 2 aor.;
	⟪1.⟫ ⟪to stand by⟫ or ⟪beside one⟫: c. dat. pers., ⟦Acts 1:10|Ac 1:10⟧ ⟦Acts 9:39|9:39⟧ ⟦Acts 23:2|23:2⟧ ⟦Acts 27:23|27:23⟧; ptcp., ⟦Mark 14:47|Mk 14:47⟧, ⟦Mark 14:69|69⟧, ⟦Mark 14:70|70⟧ ⟦Mark 15:35|15:35⟧, ⟦Mark 15:39|39⟧, ⟦John 18:22|Jo 18:22⟧ ⟦John 19:26|19:26⟧.
	⟪2.⟫ ⟪to appear⟫: c. nom. pred., seq. ἐνώπιον, ⟦Acts 4:10|Ac 4:10⟧; c. dat. pers., ⟦Acts 27:24|Ac 27:24⟧; so fut. mid. (of. LS, s.v., B, ii, 2), ⟦Romans 14:10|Ro 14:10⟧.
	⟪3.⟫ ⟪to be at hand⟫, ⟪be present⟫, ⟪have come⟫: ⟦Acts 4:26|Ac 4:26⟧(LXX); of servants in attendance, ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, ⟦Luke 1:19|Lk 1:19⟧; absol., οἱ παρεστῶτες, ⟦Luke 19:24|Lk 19:24⟧; seq. αὐτῷ, ⟦Acts 23:2|Ac 23:2⟧, ⟦Acts 23:4|4⟧; of time, ⟦Mark 4:29|Mk 4:29⟧.
	⟪4.⟫ ⟪to stand by⟫ for help or defence (Hom., Dem., Xen., al.): c. dat. pers., ⟦Romans 16:2|Ro 16:2⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 4:17|II Ti 4:17⟧.†
a: A Greek-English Lexicon, by H. G. Liddell and R. Scott. Seventh Edition. Harper, 1889

G3938.b:
⟪πάρ-οδος⟫, -ου, ἡ,
[in LXX: ⟦Genesis 38:14|Ge 38:14⟧ (⁨דֶּרֶךְ⁩), etc.;] ⟪a passing⟫ or ⟪passage⟫: ἐν π., ⟪in passing⟫, ⟦1 Corinthians 16:7|I Co 16:7⟧.†

G3939.b:
⟪παρ-οικέω⟫, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨גּוּר⁩, also for ⁨ישׁב⁩, ⁨שׁכן⁩;]
⟪1⟫ in cl., ⟪to dwell beside⟫ (c. acc.), ⟪among⟫ (c. dat.) or ⟪near by⟫ (absol.).
⟪2⟫ In late writers, ⟪to dwell⟫ in a place ⟪as a⟫ πάροικος (q.v.) or ⟪stranger⟫: ⟦Luke 24:18|Lk 24:18⟧, ⟦Hebrews 11:9|He 11:9⟧.†
